recipe.visualDefinition: A candid, warm-toned outdoor portrait of a male subject in profile, featuring a bright, overexposed sky background and heavy, distressed slab-serif typography spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's arm in the foreground creates a diagonal lead-in line to the face.
Typography acts as a heavy header, anchoring the bright upper third of the frame.
Contrast between the sharp, textured text and the soft, shallow depth-of-field photography.
coreInvariants: Profile or three-quarter view of the subject looking away from the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, slightly off-center, with a close-up focus on the head and shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale header text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large text, move down to the subject's face, and follow the arm towards the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive bright negative space in the upper background behind the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and neutral grays/blues in clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and earthy brown for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-hour sunlight highlights on the hair and skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) in the background with medium saturation in the subject and high contrast in the text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with condensed proportions
letterConstructionRules: Internal distressing mimicking worn paint or wood grain
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are split into two distinct color groups (e.g., first word navy, second word brown)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured slab serif paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for modern-rustic contrast.

avoid: Clean, modern geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rockwell Extra Bold with grunge mask
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab structure and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key outdoor portrait of a man with short brown hair and a slight beard, wearing a dark waffle-knit shirt. He is looking to the left and smiling. The background is a bright, overexposed white sky. The foreground features his arm crossed in front of his chest, creating a soft-focus diagonal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, condensed slab-serif title across the top edge. Use a navy blue for the first half and a dark wood-brown for the second half. Apply a heavy 'weathered paint' texture to the letters. Add a smaller, right-aligned subtitle in a clean sans-serif below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently bright to make the text pop?
Does the text have a visible distressed/grunge texture?
Is the subject's expression candid and warm?
Are the two colors in the main title distinct but harmonious?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the grunge texture on the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the distressed texture looks organic rather than repetitive.
Verify the color contrast between the text and the bright sky.
Confirm the diagonal composition of the arm leads to the face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm, high-key outdoor portrait with top-heavy, distressed slab-serif typography for a classic rustic-modern aesthetic.
